recommendation: Keep this audit as-is. Treat FHIR-8151 as the source-changing reconciliation for this repeated search-capability request family, and address any future live-site search endpoint problems under their own final Jira decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-7712 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I request from the 2015 May core ballot to add search capability across the FHIR DSTU and Continuous build sites so implementers and ballot reviewers could find content such as v3 mappings with the attribute isNormal. It was voted 7-0-1, applied for DSTU1, and later commented as already done.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-7712 was found. The request appears to have been applied historically at the site/operations layer, with a 2017 Zulip thread announcing specification search working again, and later in source by adding source/search-build.html as an active CI search page. The related FHIR-8151 reconciliation already fixed current-source links to route through [%search-location%].
additional_context: FHIR-8151 and FHIR-6849 are same-change-family Published/Persuasive search-capability requests, FHIR-7748 is a Duplicate with the same text, and FHIR-11438 is a later already-audited search enablement issue. Current source includes search-build.html in publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml and uses [%search-location%] in the navbar, home page, and footer. The live CI search-build page renders the active DuckDuckGo iframe, while the old search.cfm page is only a historical stub.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change was needed because the combined branch already contains the necessary same-family FHIR-8151 source fix and active build-scope search page.
